subject: Re: Accelerator credit unbundling & top-up pricing (BrightLabs)
messages:
From: BrightLabs Accelerator Ops <ops@brightlabs.io>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Maya R. <maya@brightlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Unbundle cohort promo credits + top-up option?

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well — quick question from our program team. We ran BrightLabs Summer Cohort (40 teams) on Redwood last quarter using the promo package you provided (10k token credits). A few teams didn't use their full allotment and we have ~120k unused credits across the cohort.

Two asks:
1) Can those unused credits be unbundled and applied as top-up credits to specific startup accounts (we'd like to split them among 8 fast-follow teams)?
2) Alternatively, can Redwood convert the cohort leftover credits into a pilot / trial discount or a short-term reserved capacity discount for the cohort (e.g., 20% off Dedicated for 3 months) so teams can move to production without hitting cost walls?

Attached is a usage summary for the cohort and the program T&Cs. We know this is outside standard promo policy but would like to understand options and any required approvals.

Thanks — Samir

[Attachment: BrightLabs_Cohort_Usage_Summary.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: BrightLabs_Program_Terms_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Samir Khanna <samir@brightlabs.io>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Unbundle cohort promo credits + top-up option?

Samir — thanks for the detailed note and the attachments. I pulled the usage file and it helps a lot. Short answer: we can explore a one-off for accelerator partners but it will need approvals from Sales Ops, Finance, and Legal.

To move quickly, could you:
- Confirm the eight teams you want to top up (names + account IDs)
- Indicate whether you want the credits allocated as token credits (hosted) or a pricing concession (discount on Dedicated/reserved hours)

I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to propose a few concrete options and provide ballpark economics. If we can get legal comfortable with terms (limited window, no resale), we can do a DocuSign amendment and a short SLA carveout for the cohort.

Talk soon,

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Unbundle cohort promo credits + top-up option?

Olga / Marissa — saw Samir's ask. Quick internal thoughts before we reply:

Option A — Direct allocation (hosted token credits):
- Move the 120k unused tokens into 8 named accounts; simplest operationally.
- Policy risk: precedent for future cohorts; require explicit non-resale clause in amendment.
- Revenue impact: headcount minimal; costless for us aside from token uniting — favorable for partner motion.

Option B — Convert to temporary Dedicated discount:
- Offer cohort-wide seat discount (e.g., 20% off Dedicated for 3 months) applied via promo code or billing memo.
- Better for teams moving to production; preserves controlling units.
- Requires Finance sign-off on discount run-rate and a 3-month cap.

Option C — Hybrid: allocate a portion as hosted credits and offer a one-time Dedicated top-up credit pool (e.g., $6k equivalent) that gets auto-applied if teams spin up Dedicated within 90 days.

If we go A or C, Legal will want a short amendment; Finance wants cap language and reporting. I'm leaning to C as the least risky and highest impact.

Numbers: assuming 120k tokens ~ $1,200 list equivalent at our current promo rate. If we provide $6k Dedicated top-up pool + split remaining tokens across 8 teams (15k each), that's a reasonable balance.

Notes: Marissa — can you sanity-check impact on our promo budget and whether we have precedent for the Dedicated top-up pool?

Ben
Sr. Manager, Partnerships
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Unbundle cohort promo credits + top-up option?

Ben — thanks, agree with leaning on C. A few execution items: 
- Promo budget: we can approve a $6k top-up from the accelerator partner fund if Sales Ops documents the case and we cap it to cohorts that convert within 90 days.
- Billing flow: Engineering Ops can create a one-off credit item applied to invoices; need GL code and expiration date.
- Legal redlines: add non-resale + explicit cohort list + 90-day activation window. I can draft language.

If everyone agrees, I propose we:
1) Send Samir a proposal that splits the leftover 120k into 15k token allocations for 8 named teams + create a $6k Dedicated top-up credit pool for the cohort (redeemable within 90 days).
2) Attach a short amendment (one page) that includes non-resale, cap, and activation.
3) Request Samir confirm team list and sign the amendment; Finance will flag the $6k charge to promotions.

I'll prepare the amendment draft and the billing memo. Olga — want me to loop Legal now or after Samir confirms?

Marissa
Partner Ops Lead
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Samir Khanna <samir@brightlabs.io>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: BrightLabs cohort leftover credits — allocation + Dedicated top-up

Samir — thanks for the patience while we reviewed this internally. Below is what Redwood can do as a one-time exception for BrightLabs Summer Cohort: 

Proposal (one-time accelerator exception):
- Token allocations: 120,000 unused tokens to be split into 8 named startup accounts (15,000 tokens each). These will be applied to hosted billing and expire 90 days from the amendment signature date.
- Dedicated top-up: Redwood will issue a $6,000 top-up credit pool redeemable towards Dedicated reserved capacity (applied as an invoice credit). Redemption window: 90 days from signature.
- Conditions: non-resale clause, no further conversion to cash, cohort teams must be named in the amendment, amendment must be signed by BrightLabs program director.
- Finance notes: $6,000 promo charge will be booked to Q3 promotions budget; token allocations are zero-revenue adjustments.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the 8 recipient startups (name + Redwood account id).
2) Confirm you accept the 90-day activation window and non-resale terms.
3) Once confirmed, we'll send a one-page amendment via DocuSign (link below) and provision the tokens/top-up within 48 business hours of signature.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-123-BRIGHTLABS

If you want a different split or a larger top-up we can revisit but that will need VP-level approval.

Thanks,
Olga
Partner Sales
Redwood Inference
